links.context: The module-gap grid is a structural feature of the detector overlaid on the scattering pattern captured in the same frame.

Thin horizontal and vertical black lines partition the frame into a grid of rectangular regions, consistent with inactive gaps between sensor modules/tiles on a pixel array detector (e.g., a 1-megapixel class detector implied by the filename 'det_1m').

Image shows a dark background with a bright vertical streak crossing a bright horizontal streak near the beam center, plus a distinct comet-shaped bright spot with a tail below-right of center — characteristic of a 2D area-detector X-ray scattering/diffraction frame with a direct-beam or specular streak and a Bragg/diffuse scattering feature.
